scenario: 今天的具身智能赛道在问，模型和数据怎样穿过不同身体、不同传感器，以及仿真和真机之间的缝。一组世界-动作模型不再把几乎不动的背景再预测一遍，而是去学画面里真正在变的部分，有的在执行前先用自己提出的动作去改对未来的想象，再把动作收紧。另一组把异质触觉收成可共用的表示，有的锚定到六维力和力矩，有的先映到同一套指尖坐标。人形这边，有人只靠眼镜视频在仿真里生成可验证的全身轨迹，不必先在真机上录示范，有人用触觉历史在真机上零样本拧开圆形门把手，也有一条抓取策略想跨过多种臂和手。同日的综述提醒，仿真基准上接近满分，并不等于物体或相机稍一移动还站得住。

papers.title: Ego2Sim2Humanoid: Agentic Real-to-Sim for Learning Loco-Manipulation VLAs without Robot Demonstrations
papers.abstract: Imitation learning for visuomotor policies typically relies on teleoperated robot demonstrations, which are costly because every episode requires a trained operator controlling a physical robot in real time through teleoperation interfaces and wearable body-tracking hardware. Egocentric glasses capture human demonstrations without a robot or handheld grippers, yet they track only the head and in-view human hands, and directly copying human motion to a robot with different stature, arm reach and hand morphology fails to produce feasible contacts. \method{} converts egocentric glasses recordings into physically verified robot training trajectories. An agentic real-to-sim stage reconstructs collision and textured visual assets from the recorded RGB-D and head streams, completes unseen surfaces when needed, and predicts target contact bands on the manipulated objects. During motion adaptation, a grasp planner turns each contact band into a feasible robot wrist pose and finger closure, bilevel stance optimization plans collision-free standing postures that keep hand targets reachable, and a whole-body motion generator synthesizes lower-body locomotion and out-of-view arm motion. Two-stage motion correction then blends visibility transitions kinematically and trains a reinforcement-learning tracking policy in physics simulation under agent-designed semantic rewards, completing manipulation phases even when the object leaves the camera view. Rendering the reconstructed scene through the robot's onboard camera along the optimized rollout yields synchronized robot-view images, proprioception and verified action labels. Fine-tuned exclusively on this converted dataset, without real-robot demonstrations, GR00T N1.7 performed loco-manipulation tasks autonomously on a Unitree G1. Project page: https://robonana.github.io/ego2sim2humanoid/
papers.summary: 用第一人称眼镜录下人的操作，虽然不必占用真机，可人的身材和手型跟机器人不同，把人手动作直接搬过去，常常够不着也抓不稳。这套方法从眼镜画面和头部轨迹重建场景，规划出机器人够得着、不穿透物体的站位和抓取，再在物理仿真里补全全身动作，并按机器人相机视角渲染训练画面。只靠这批转换数据、不用目标任务的真机示范，微调后的全身 VLA 在 Unitree G1 上二十次试验里，有九次举起瓶子（45%），有五次把帽子戴到头上（25%）。==先把人的录像变成物理上站得住的机器人轨迹，再拿去微调==。对要给人形收集边走边操作数据的人来说，录制时可以只戴眼镜，不必把机器人也占上。

papers.title: ResWAM: Learning What Changes, Not What Stays, for World-Action Models
papers.authors: Chongyu Fan, Gaowen Liu, Ramana Rao Kompella, Jason Corso, Sijia Liu
papers.abstract: World-action models (WAMs) augment vision-language-action policies (VLAs) with future prediction so that the policy can anticipate how its actions will affect the physical world. Existing WAMs supervise complete future observations. However, observations typically change little over an action chunk, so the future loss is dominated by copying static background content rather than learning task-relevant robot and object motion, limiting policy learning. Moreover, existing WAMs rely on large video generation models or separate world models, incurring heavy training and inference compute that hinders closed-loop deployment. To improve policy performance, we propose visual residual learning, supervising only the feature change from the current frame to the future frame in a frozen DINOv3 space. Compared with complete future features, this residual learning target yields a higher feature rank with richer and more diverse representations of scene changes, and spatially concentrates on the robot arm and manipulated objects rather than the background. To further improve computational efficiency, we present ResWAM, a residual world-action model with 2.3B parameters in total, including a lightweight 0.5B dual-branch DiT that jointly trains an action branch and a residual branch via conditional flow matching. Without robot pretraining (i.e., pretraining on external robot action trajectories beyond the benchmark demonstrations), ResWAM achieves top average success rates on LIBERO-Plus (81.1%), RoboTwin 2.0 (93.8%), and RoboDojo (9.40% success, 13.41 score) at the lowest training (2.7-4.0 TFLOPs) and inference compute (1.0-1.4 TFLOPs), and leads real-robot Open, Put, and Stack (80.0% average, +10.0% over $\pi_{0.5}$) at 92.7 ms latency.
papers.summary: 给动作策略再加未来预测，本意是让模型想到动作会怎样改变世界，可一段动作里画面往往几乎不动，完整未来的损失就被静止背景带走。这篇工作只在冻结的视觉特征里监督当前帧到未来帧的残差，残差更集中在机械臂和被操作的物体上。据此做出的残差世界-动作模型总参数约二十三亿，不用在基准以外的机器人轨迹上预训练。真机上打开、放置和码放三项任务平均成功率 80.0%，比最强对照高出 10 个百分点，单段动作推理只要 92.7 毫秒。==要学的是画面里正在变的部分，而不是把没动的背景再抄一遍==。对要在真机上闭环部署的人来说，计算可以花在变化上，而不必再背一个沉重的视频生成模型。

papers.title: TMA: Sim-to-Real Forceful Humanoid Manipulation via Tactile-Driven Motor Adaptation
papers.authors: Yiting Chen, Kelin Yu, Sarthak Kaingade, Bryan Trinh, Kaiyu Hang, Roberto Martin-martin, Nima Fazeli, X. Alice Wu
papers.abstract: Recent humanoid loco-manipulation in articulated environments has largely focused on geometry-dominant interactions, where success is primarily determined by geometric alignment and motion execution. In contrast, forceful multi-finger manipulation requires the robot to adapt to real-world uncertainties in contact and interaction dynamics. We present Tactile-Driven Motor Adaptation (TMA) and an integrated whole-body system for zero-shot sim-to-real forceful humanoid manipulation, and study round-doorknob opening as a challenging benchmark requiring stable multi-finger frictional grasping, sufficient torque generation without slip, force-regulated pushing, and whole-body stability. TMA structures policy learning around interactions observable through tactile feedback, uses cone geometry as an inductive bias for multi-finger contact representation, and adapts motor behavior online from tactile history. An upper-body manipulation policy is trained alongside a pretrained general locomotion controller to coordinate dexterous interaction and whole-body stabilization. Trained entirely in simulation, TMA transfers zero-shot to a Unitree G1 humanoid with BrainCo Revo2 multi-fingered hands and substantially outperforms standard Rapid Motor Adaptation (RMA) and reactive tactile policy baselines across four commercial round doorknobs in the real world.
papers.summary: 人形在带铰链的环境里做全身操作，过去多半靠几何对准，可要用力拧开圆形门把手，还得在真实接触里随时改力，整机还不能失去平衡。这套方法把策略学习围绕手指能感觉到的接触来组织，并根据触觉历史在线改运动。上肢策略与预先训练好的行走控制器一起协调，完全在仿真里训练，再零样本搬到装有多指手的 Unitree G1 上。仿真里用完整触觉时开门成功率 80.9%，只用是否接触则是 73.6%。真机上四种市售旋钮、每种十次、不再微调，它明显优于只靠本体感觉适应的对照。==在不能靠关节回推出力的手上，光看本体感觉，看不出该用多大力==。对要人形去开真实房门的人来说，力和接触历史得写进适应环里。

papers.title: DexFormer 2.0: Towards a Cross-Embodiment Foundation Policy for Dexterous Grasping
papers.authors: Lixin Xu, Ke Zhang, Xinyu Liu, Jie Tan, Senming Tan, Jiaju Yin, Yating Feng, Xiaoyi Lin, Xiyue Dong, Renjing Xu
papers.abstract: Dexterous grasping policies are usually trained for one arm paired with one hand. Every new pairing then needs its own policy, and the number of policies grows with every arm and hand added. We ask whether a single policy can control many arm-hand combinations and transfer to pairings and hands it has never seen. This is hard because robots differ in the number, layout, and dynamics of their joints, so their observations and actions share no common interface. We present DexFormer 2.0, a single reinforcement learning policy for cross-embodiment dexterous grasping. It maps every robot to a canonical joint interface with validity masks, encodes each joint's morphology with attention biased by the kinematic tree, and uses a Transformer-XL memory to infer embodiment-dependent dynamics from recent interaction. Trained on 18 combinations of four arms and six hands, it reaches 89% stable success on seen combinations and 51% on six held-out arm-hand pairs, outperforming GRU and DexFormer 1.0 baselines. Without fine-tuning, it also grasps with four new hand types and, through retargeting, with parallel grippers. Ablations show that memory, the kinematic-tree bias, and broader pairing coverage each matter for transfer. On a physical Flexiv arm, distilled students transfer zero-shot from simulation with two hands, including a held-out pair. Project website: https://davidlxu.github.io/dexformer2-web/.
papers.summary: 灵巧抓取的策略通常按一只胳膊配一只手来训练，每多一种搭配就要再训一条。难处在于不同机器人的关节数量和布局都不一样，观察和动作没有共用接口。这条强化学习策略把每台机器人映到带有效掩码的标准关节接口上，用运动学树偏置注意力，再用短时记忆从最近交互里推断这具身体的动力学。它在十八种臂手搭配上训练，在见过的组合上稳定成功率 89.01%，在训练时没见过的六种搭配上是 51.18%。在真实 Flexiv 臂上，仿真里蒸馏出的学生策略可零样本部署，不必再做真机微调。==先把不同臂和手写成同一套关节接口，一条策略才有机会跨身体复用==。对产线里要换手或换臂的人来说，这比每换一副搭配就重训一条更省事。

papers.title: Learning Heterogeneous Tactile Representation for General Dexterous Manipulation
papers.authors: Bing Han, Yichuan Peng, Haoyu Dong, Yuanmeng Hu, Yongyi Jia, Fangjing Wang, Kecheng Zheng, Yiming Zhang, Yanhong Zeng, Xiaoqing Zhang, Chen Song, Rundong Zou, Anqi Dong, Yuan Guan, Ka Leong Cheng, Xing Zhu, Yujun Shen, Nan Xue, Wei Ning
papers.abstract: Tactile sensing is an indispensable modality for contact-rich dexterous manipulation, a capability that hints at the ultimate frontiers of embodied intelligence. However, commercially available tactile sensors are still at a relatively early stage of development, with each type of sensor offering irreplaceable strengths alongside its own drawbacks. A key challenge is thus to free tactile understanding from sensor-specific physics, so that embodied models can effectively leverage heterogeneous tactile data. To this end, we develop LingBot-Touch, a tactile foundation model characterized by the following properties. (i) Our model yields a unified representation across different tactile sensors (i.e., piezoresistive, magnetic, and visuotactile sensors), and is easily extensible to new sensor types. (ii) The resulting tactile tokens are plug-and-play: they can be seamlessly integrated into policy models across paradigms, from diffusion policy to vision-language-action (VLA) models such as $\pi_{0.5}$ and LingBot-VLA, consistently enhancing manipulation dexterity. (iii) Extensive experiments, spanning simulation and real-robot deployments across multiple hardware platforms, demonstrate that our tactile representation substantially benefits complex manipulation tasks while maintaining strong computational efficiency. We believe the findings in this work demonstrate the potential of leveraging cross-sensor data to scale tactile learning, and offer encouraging insights for the design of future hardware and embodied models.
papers.summary: 接触丰富的灵巧操作离不开触觉，可压阻、磁感和视觉触觉的信号形貌不同，策略很难直接吃进去。这篇工作把不同传感器的触点先映到同一套指尖坐标里，用一个编码器在潜空间里做自监督预测，得到可插进现有策略的触觉 token。编码器保持冻结，在二十六项真机双臂任务上，它把四种策略的平均成功率提高了 13.9 到 24.8 个百分点。若只是把原始触觉信号加进去，最多只能拿到大约一半的提升，有时还会干扰本来已经会用的视觉。==先把不同传感器读成同一套指尖表示，策略才能用上接触，而不是被原始信号拽偏==。对要在多种手上复用触觉数据的人来说，关键是先有一套跨传感器的表示。

papers.title: TaF-Foundation: Wrench-Grounded Cross-Sensor Tactile Representations
papers.authors: Jiaming Jiang, Yuzhe Huang, Baokun Yang, Hao Liang, Li Gao, Haoran Guo, Pei Lin, Shengcheng Luo, Chenxi Xiao, Wanlin Li, Ziyuan Jiao
papers.abstract: Tactile sensing is essential for contact-rich manipulation, yet heterogeneous sensing mechanisms and observation formats hinder cross-hardware transfer. Since physical contact is governed by Newtonian mechanics, we ground tactile representations in six-dimensional wrenches, establishing a common physical reference across sensing mechanisms. Specifically, we pair tactile observations from all sensors with wrench measurements, enabling shared physical supervision without requiring direct tactile-to-tactile pairing between sensors. To support learning at scale, we develop a dedicated acquisition platform and collect over 100 million paired tactile observations and wrench measurements from 24 sensors spanning four families of sensing principles. Building on this dataset, our framework combines sensor-specific input adaptation with a shared tactile encoder. By learning to reconstruct wrenches, the encoder maps observations from different sensors into a shared, continuous feature space grounded in contact physics. To leverage these representations for manipulation, we introduce TaF-Policy, which integrates tactile features with visual observations and robot states to generate action chunks. We evaluate the learned representations through wrench estimation, cross-sensor retrieval, few-shot adaptation to unseen sensors, and robotic manipulation. On the core benchmark, our method reduces single-frame force RMSE by 17.1% and improves cross-sensor retrieval R@1 by 13.11 percentage points over the strongest baseline. In manipulation experiments, TaF-Policy achieves average success rates of 51.33% across three simulated tasks and 46.25% across four real-world tasks, compared with 47.33% and 23.75%, respectively, for the strongest baselines evaluated on the same task sets. Project page: https://mrjiangjm.github.io/TaF-Foundation/.
papers.summary: 不同原理的触觉传感器观测格式对不上，一套表示很难从一种硬件转到另一种。这篇工作把触觉表示锚定在六维力和力矩上，让不同传感器都与力和力矩成对，而不要求传感器之间直接对齐触觉信号。他们从四个家族的二十四只传感器上收集了超过一亿对观测，靠重建力和力矩把不同读数映到同一套特征里。在核心基准上，单帧力误差比最强对照降低 17.1%，跨传感器检索第一名命中率提高 13.11 个百分点。接到策略后，四项真机任务平均成功率 46.25%，最强对照是 23.75%。==不同触觉传感器要对齐，先对齐它们共同的力和力矩==。对混用多种触觉硬件的人来说，这不必再做传感器两两配对。

papers.title: DiffWAM: Learning World Action Model from Consecutive Visual Difference
papers.authors: Xinheng Zhang, Haoyu Xiong, Chao Jing, Xiaohan Zhang, Linshan Li, Hongbang Fan, Xingyu Chen
papers.abstract: World Action Models (WAMs) have emerged as an important paradigm in robot learning, jointly predicting future scene states and robot actions from current observations and instructions. However, future states entangle task-related changes with large amounts of task-irrelevant content, such as static backgrounds, which weakens the model's ability to capture changes relevant to task execution. To address this, we propose Difference World Action Model (DiffWAM), a Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) framework that enhances world representations by jointly learning future-state prediction and consecutive visual difference prediction. We define consecutive visual differences as differences between the latent representations of consecutive observations, providing an explicit learning signal for temporal variation. The framework comprises a World Expert for future frame prediction, an Action Expert for action generation, and a Diff Expert for predicting these latent differences along the trajectory. A structured unidirectional attention mask conditions the Diff, World, and Action Experts solely on the current-frame representation while blocking attention between experts. This design allows both the World and Diff Experts to be removed during inference, introducing no additional inference overhead. DiffWAM achieves state-of-the-art performance on the LIBERO and RoboTwin 2.0 benchmarks and substantially improves over FastWAM on real-world manipulation tasks. Specifically, it attains average success rates of 98.8%, 92.65%, and 88.3%, outperforming the state-of-the-art baseline (i.e., FastWAM) by 1.75, 1.55, and 15.0 percentage points, respectively.
papers.summary: 世界-动作模型会同时预测未来画面和机器人动作，可未来状态把任务相关的变化和大量不动的背景缠在一起，模型就不容易抓住真正影响执行的那些改变。这篇工作在预测未来状态的同时，再单独预测相邻观测在潜空间里的差值，给时间上的变化一条明确的学习信号。部署时可以把负责未来和差值的分支拿掉，不增加额外推理开销。在 LIBERO 上平均成功率 98.8%，在三项真机操作上是 88.3%，比最强对照高出 15 个百分点。==训练时把变化单独学出来，部署时可以把预测未来的分支卸掉，不必为此拖慢控制==。对已经在用这类模型、却担心推理变慢的人来说，这把训练信号和上线路径分开了。

papers.title: ThinkWAM: Rethinking Latent Futures for Action Refinement
papers.authors: Haoyun Tang, Baqiao Deng, Enjin Zhou, Songwen Tian, Keyao Xu, Bowen Jing, Kun Wang, Ke Ma, Zhandong Mei, Huibin Li
papers.abstract: World-action models (WAMs) couple action generation with predictions of future states. An initial action chunk may be flawed. A future prediction that is not conditioned on the chunk may fail to reflect the changes that the proposed actions would induce in visual representations, limiting its usefulness for refinement before execution. We introduce ThinkWAM, a latent WAM that establishes bidirectional feedback before execution through a proposal-rethink-refine loop: the policy first proposes a complete action chunk, the proposal corrects multi-horizon future latents through a learned residual, and the corrected latents are injected into a second pass of the same action head, which generates the executable chunk. An affordance-guided observation-action memory and a near-fine, far-coarse multi-horizon prediction scheme, both motivated by predictive coding, support this loop, and all prediction stays in latent space. ThinkWAM achieves 98.70% success on LIBERO, 84.76% on LIBERO-Plus without OOD fine-tuning, 85.75%/65.85% on RoboTwin 2.0 Clean/Random, and 65.17% on RoboCasa24. ThinkWAM achieves 64.4% mean success across three real-world OOD conditions. The mean two-pass inference latency per action chunk is 153.48 ms on LIBERO, 164.61 ms on RoboTwin, and 101.2 ms on the Galaxea A1Z. Ablations show complementary gains from rethinking and affordance guidance. Diagnostics indicate that proposal-conditioned corrections change both predicted futures and action trajectories, showing that the corrected future representations improve the final action.
papers.summary: 世界-动作模型一边出动作、一边预测未来，可第一稿动作片段常常有缺陷。若未来预测并不以这稿动作为条件，它就反映不出这些动作会怎样改写视觉表示，执行前也就很难据此把动作改好。这篇工作让策略先提出完整一段动作，再用它修正多个时间范围的未来潜变量，把修正后的未来注入同一个动作头的第二遍，得到真正执行的片段。在不做分布外微调的 LIBERO-Plus 上成功率 84.76%，在三种真机分布外条件下平均 64.4%，真机上一段动作的两遍推理平均只要 101.2 毫秒。==先用自己提出的动作去改对未来的想象，再根据改过的未来把动作收紧==。对要在发出去之前改一稿的人来说，未来预测应当看到即将执行的那一段。

papers.title: Action Intent as a Bridge: Transferring Manipulation Knowledge from Human-Centric Videos to Robots
papers.authors: Zhiqian Xia, Lianyang Ma, Haifeng Xia, Siyu Xia, Wei Wang, Xiaochun Cao
papers.abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have achieved promising performance for generalized robotic manipulation, yet their reliance on expensive real-robot data remains a fundamental bottleneck. A scalable alternative is to transfer knowledge from off-the-shelf human-centric videos. However, existing methods extract latent action representations that are entangled with scene-specific noise, diluting the transferred knowledge. Motivated by this limitation, we propose Action-Intent Transfer (AIT), a two-stage method that transfers knowledge through a clean action representation shared across humans and robots. In the first stage, AIT extracts explicit action intents and disentangles the implicit action intent from manipulation videos. In the second stage, AIT aligns the human and robot domains within this shared intent space and decodes the intent into executable robot actions. Extensive experiments in both simulation and real-world environments demonstrate that AIT transfers human knowledge more effectively and consistently outperforms prior baselines.
papers.summary: 视觉-语言-动作模型要泛化操作，往往还得靠昂贵的真机数据。现成的人类视频本来是更可扩展的路，可现有方法抽出的潜动作常常和场景噪声缠在一起，迁过去的知识就被稀释了。这篇工作用一个人和机器人共用的动作意图来做迁移，先从视频里抽出意图，在共享空间里对齐两个领域，再解码成可执行的动作。在十二项真机任务上平均成功率 82.08%，比同样用人类视频预训练的对照 70.42% 更高。==人和机器人之间要迁的，应是干净的动作意图，而不是和某一场景绑在一起的潜动作==。对想用人类视频补真机示范不足的人来说，先约定双方都认得的意图，再解码成关节动作，比直接对齐视频特征更稳。

papers.title: Vision-Language-Action Models: A Life-Cycle Survey of Design, Training and Deployment
papers.abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA) models adapt web-pretrained vision-language models to output robot actions, so that web knowledge carries over to physical control. In under 4 years the field has moved from RT-2, the first VLA, to open models that fine-tune on a single consumer GPU and to proprietary generalists that clean unseen homes. This survey reviews 88 works from December 2022 to October 2026, mainly on manipulation and navigation, plus humanoid control, world-action models and evaluation. We follow a VLA through its life cycle, from model design to training and deployment, along seven axes. Model design covers (a) inputs and memory, what the model observes; (b) architecture, how its pipeline is built; (c) action output, how it produces motor commands; and (d) intermediate predictions, what else it predicts, from reasoning steps to future observations. Training covers (e) pretraining data, the mix of robot, web, human and simulated data, and (f) post-training, adaptation to the target robot. Deployment covers (g) real-time execution, keeping pace with the robot. We analyse 22 models on these axes and report their training data, model size, inference speed and hardware. Three trends emerge: (i) training data has broadened, from about 10,000 hours of teleoperated robot data ($\pi_0$) to 23,000 community-collected episodes (SmolVLA) and 20,000 hours of egocentric human video (GR00T N1.7); (ii) model sizes have split: most recent models have 3-7 billion parameters, while a new group under one billion runs on consumer GPUs; and (iii) generalist VLAs are emerging that handle both manipulation and navigation, such as UniVLA and Qwen-VLA. We also compare VLAs with world-action models, which predict future observations as well as actions. We review evidence that some VLAs with near-perfect benchmark scores fail when objects or the camera move slightly, and open up further research questions.
papers.summary: 视觉-语言-动作模型在常用仿真基准上已接近满分，可这些分数并不等于物体或相机稍一移动还站得住。这篇综述沿设计、训练和部署的生命周期，梳理了二〇二二年十二月到二〇二六年十月的八十八项工作。训练数据已从遥操作真机扩展到社区轨迹和第一人称人类视频，模型也分成了三十到七十亿参数的主流，以及能在消费级 GPU 上跑的十亿以下一组。更要紧的是，标准 LIBERO 上超过 90% 的模型，在物体稍稍离开训练位置时成功率会掉到零。改相机视角或起始姿态时，成功率会从约 95% 降到 30% 以下。==只看接近满分的仿真分数，看不出模型在稍有变化的场景里有多脆==。对要选模型或报结果的人来说，应补上扰动测试，并写清训练数据和延迟。
